strings.name: Omar Yaghi
strings.summary: Born in Amman, Yaghi moved to the US as a teenager. His teams developed metal–organic and covalent organic frameworks for gas storage, separation and atmospheric water harvesting. He shared the 2025 chemistry Nobel with Kitagawa and Robson. In 2026 he joined Tsinghua full-time for AI-assisted materials research; experimental promise does not establish widespread deployment.
strings.influence.rationale: Advances reticular chemistry and metal–organic frameworks, providing materials approaches to gas storage, separation and water technologies.
strings.facts.f2.value: BS, SUNY Albany (1985); PhD, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (1990).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Designing porous networks
strings.highlights.h1.text: Linked molecular building blocks into designed frameworks, developing reticular chemistry methods.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Exploring resource applications
strings.highlights.h2.text: Teams studied framework adsorption of gases and water for energy and environmental uses.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Joined Tsinghua full-time
strings.timeline.t1.text: Became chair professor, leading establishment of an AI, materials and chemistry institute.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Shared chemistry Nobel
strings.timeline.t2.text: Honoured with Kitagawa and Robson for developing metal–organic frameworks.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Joined Berkeley
strings.timeline.t3.text: Joined UC Berkeley, continuing porous materials and reticular chemistry research.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Developed covalent organic frameworks
strings.timeline.t4.text: With collaborators reported covalent organic frameworks, extending network construction to organic materials.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Reported MOF-5
strings.timeline.t5.text: The team reported permanently porous MOF-5, advancing stable porous framework research.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Began independent research
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined Arizona State as assistant professor, establishing an independent research programme.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earned chemistry doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed his Illinois doctorate, then undertook postdoctoral research at Harvard.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Amman
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born into a Palestinian refugee family; moved to the US for study as a teenager.
